heard: There are four specific rocks in space currently on a collision course with our planet. And none of them are theoretical. One of them even has a name. In 2004, astronomers gave it a 2, 7% chance of hitting Earth. That number sounds small. It is not. For an object the size of three football fields, it is the highest risk ever recorded.

There are four specific rocks in space currently on a collision course with our planet, and none of them are theoretical. One of them even has a name, Apophis.
